title: Hermes Delivery Gate
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 delivery gate decisions. Every outbound path must pass delivery gate. No allowlist, no delivery.

reason_codes.description: Reason codes for the decision (e.g., platform_not_allowlisted, quiet_hours, delivery_consent_withdrawn).

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the delivery gate decision.

target_hash.description: Optional. Hash of the target for logging without raw IDs.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was made.
